subject: compiled code when fitting a stan model in R

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: compiled code when fitting a stan model in R
parts:
Hi, I ran in R:

schools <- read.csv ("schools.csv", header=TRUE)
J <- nrow (schools)
y <- schools$estimate
sigma <- schools$sd
library ("rstan")
schools_fit <- stan (file="schools.stan", iter = 1000, chains = 4)

All fine, but it required recompilation, even though I’d fit the model before (in an earlier R session). I recall stan in R automatically saving compiled code in my working directory. Does this no longer happen? Can I turn this feature back on? I hate having to recompile like this.

Thx
A

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: compiled code when fitting a stan model in R
parts:
On Thursday, October 15, 2015 at 5:01:59 PM UTC-4, Andrew Gelman wrote:
All fine, but it required recompilation, even though I’d fit the model before (in an earlier R session).  I recall stan in R automatically saving compiled code in my working directory.  Does this no longer happen?  Can I turn this feature back on?   I hate having to recompile like this.

The feature is still there, but it chooses to recompile a model in several circumstances. The most likely one is that you compiled it previously with (R) Stan 2.7.x and now have rstan 2.8.0. In that case, it will recompile the model once.

Ben
